objective: Build the separate OfRoot Technology Phase 2 Clinic Success foundation without accessing Health data.

nodes.title: Review the cross-application contract
nodes.objective: Establish the permitted Technology inputs, outputs, and privacy boundary.

nodes.title: Identify a separate Technology persistence target
nodes.objective: Verify the backend, database, migration owner, and environment for Clinic Success.

nodes.title: Define CRM integration readiness boundary
nodes.objective: Specify a clinic-isolated, non-live CRM adapter contract without expanding the Health-data boundary.

nodes.title: Approve the dedicated Technology backend and database target
nodes.objective: Name the non-Health data store, migration authority, signing-secret owner, deployment environment, and rollback path.

nodes.title: Verify Technology target configuration and run read-only schema inspection
nodes.objective: Confirm `mkgycihcekojbvmsexgv` is reachable through the configured MCP connection and inspect its schema without mutation.

nodes.title: Create a smallest reviewable Technology implementation plan
nodes.objective: Reconcile current source patterns with a separate target-local clinic/referral/event model and validation plan.
inputs: source store, webhook patterns, and Clinic Success contract

nodes.title: Verify Vercel receiver endpoint and environment boundary
nodes.objective: Determine whether the newly added Vercel configuration belongs to the separate Technology receiver and is sufficient for local route implementation.
inputs: Vercel project metadata and environment variable metadata

nodes.title: Create clinic-scoped referral and event-ledger schema
nodes.objective: Implement isolated referrals, lifecycle events, and aggregate projections with no health-bearing fields.
inputs: approved database target and migration workflow

nodes.title: Verify selected receiver host and current release source
nodes.objective: Confirm main-website Production domain/source and the Technology Supabase target in the current authenticated browser session.
inputs: current Chrome Vercel and Supabase sessions
outputs: verified host, source commit, domain, and database target

nodes.title: Implement signed referral issuance and event receiver
nodes.objective: Create opaque referral URLs and a fail-closed HMAC/timestamp/version/idempotency/replay protected receiver.
nodes.blockingReason: Local release and real-database integration pass. Production publication, live bad-signature rejection, Health-emitted accepted/duplicate behavior, and final database readback remain.

nodes.title: Create aggregate-only dashboard groundwork
nodes.objective: Expose per-clinic lifecycle counts only after the event ledger is proven correct.

nodes.title: Implement the disconnected CRM outbox and mapping boundary
nodes.objective: Add clinic-isolated adapter records, immutable mappings, outbox idempotency, and sync-health projections without a live CRM connection.
outputs: schema and isolated tests; no CRM network calls
nodes.blockingReason: Disconnected CRM tables exist only in the unapplied migration artifact; no runtime integration or database validation exists.
